reproduce_first.note: The new end-to-end test failed before the implementation changed.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifically described the bug and requested a fix.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read package.json before running the project checks.

incremental_slices.note: It reproduced the bug, added the fix and unit coverage, checked them, then added coverage for stored duplicates and checked again.

self_review.note: The done summary says the agent reviewed the change for correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: The agent deliberately broke conditions and confirmed tests failed, then added coverage for the previously uncovered repair call.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The agent checked the README and reported it remained accurate.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed unrelated concerns as follow-ups instead of including them in the change.

verification_story.note: The done summary names the checks and results, and explains that no separate manual click-through was done.

hand_check.note: Playwright exercised the changed behavior in a real browser before completion.
